integrity: The exact facet table is reconstructed from the published compact notation; the checker independently derives the boundary and every interior-edge degree from those facets. No independent audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: The claim is specific to the published labeled 15-vertex triangulation. It does not assert a universal minimum-degree realization theorem for double-trefoil spanning edges, nor invariance under bistellar moves or subdivisions.
title: The double-trefoil edge is the unique degree-three interior edge of \(B_{15,66}\)
